comment: The deployments this interface reads. Every address here was deployed by safixlabs/safix and is recorded in that repository's deployments/<network>.json; nothing on any screen is invented. A NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable overrides the matching entry, which is how the money-path suite points the app at a fork.

testnet.note: The testnet carries no USDG and none of the chain's tokenized equities, so this deployment settles in its own tUSDG and lends against tBILL, bNVDA and tGOLD, which safixlabs/safix deploys with it. They are the deployment's own assets, not stand-ins drawn on a screen: every figure quoted against them is read from these contracts.
